events.title: Exact EVM scheme specified
events.detail: First committed to main as specs/scheme-exact-evm.md (commit 3e5c14a); PR #1 moved it to specs/schemes/exact/ on 2025-02-23, before the public launch.

events.title: Whitepaper and public launch
events.detail: Coinbase Developer Platform whitepaper; npm x402 0.3.0 published the same day.

events.title: First high-severity advisory
events.detail: GHSA-3j63-5h8p-gf7c for legacy resource-server packages below 0.5.2.

events.title: A2A x402 extension launched with AP2
events.detail: Google's AP2 announcement; a2a-x402 v0.1.0 released.

events.title: Cloudflare and Coinbase announce a foundation plan
events.detail: Cloudflare also proposed a deferred scheme and added x402 to its Agents SDK.

events.title: Memecoin-driven activity spike
events.detail: Nearly 500,000 transactions between 2025-10-14 and 2025-10-20 amid a wave of x402-powered memecoin launches (secondary report).

events.title: Specification v2.0 dated
events.detail: CAIP-2 networks, restructured objects, ResourceInfo, extensions.

events.title: V2 launched
events.detail: PR #705 merged and @x402/core 2.0.0 published; new header names.

events.title: Stripe machine payments preview with x402
events.detail: USDC on Base. Stripe's docs (2026-10-19) offer stablecoin payments to businesses in all US states except New York, others on request, and record each settled payment as a PaymentIntent.

events.title: Solana facilitator advisory
events.detail: GHSA-qr2g-p6q7-w82m, high severity, published by the maintainers (GitHub Advisory Database entry 2026-03-07 UTC).

events.title: Technical charter adopted
events.detail: x402 a Series of LF Projects, LLC.

events.title: Linux Foundation announces the x402 Foundation
events.detail: 22 organizations expressed intent or support.

events.title: batch-settlement scheme (formerly deferred)
events.detail: Merged with the credit-backed cloudflare:402 binding and the http-message-signatures extension.

events.title: Pay.sh reported: a Solana gateway that sells APIs over x402 and MPP
events.detail: Decrypt and The Block reported that the Solana Foundation and Google Cloud launched Pay.sh, through which agents pay per request in stablecoins on Solana, with Gemini and BigQuery among the Google Cloud services.

events.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments preview pays x402 for agents
events.detail: AWS's managed payments for agents pays x402 resources from Coinbase CDP or Stripe Privy wallets within session spending limits; the Coinbase x402 Bazaar MCP server is reachable through AgentCore Gateway.

events.title: Technical Steering Committee named
events.detail: Coinbase, Cloudflare and Stripe in TSC.md.

events.title: AWS WAF answers AI bots with x402 at the CloudFront edge
events.detail: AI traffic monetization in AWS WAF Bot Control returns an x402 402 for content on Amazon CloudFront, verifies the payment at the edge and settles it through Coinbase Developer Platform's x402 facilitator. Stripe direct-account payments and MPP were announced as coming soon.

events.title: Foundation operational launch
events.detail: 40 member organizations, 17 Premier.

events.title: Client spend controls
events.detail: @x402/core 2.23.0: spendControls with a $1 default per payment. With the SIWX origin check and a Solana TransferChecked guard in the 2.23.0 releases, it closed three critical findings V12 reported on 2026-08-12 and disclosed on 2026-10-22; no advisory was published.

events.title: AgentCore payments generally available, adding MPP and x402 upto
events.detail: General availability added Quick Create for Coinbase credentials, a curated Coinbase Bazaar MCP server, MPP support and the x402 upto scheme.

events.title: exact on Lightning (lnbtc)
events.detail: Specification only: no SDK implemented the binding by 2026-10-19.

events.title: Cloudflare Monetization Gateway closed beta
events.detail: Settles USDC on Base through Coinbase's facilitator; closed beta for eligible US-based sellers and buyers.

events.title: Executive Director appointed
events.detail: The Linux Foundation named Michael Hursta Executive Director of the x402 Foundation. A Governing Board handles budget and business oversight; the TSC makes technical decisions.

events.title: HEAD payment bypass fixed on main
events.detail: PR #3796 makes HEAD requests to GET-only paid routes require payment in TypeScript, legacy x402, Go and Python. Not in a published release on 2026-10-19; shipped on 2026-10-28 in @x402/core 2.29.0, PyPI x402 2.26.0 and Go v2.29.0, but in no legacy V1 release.

events.title: Bazaar metadata content policy
events.detail: The CDP Bazaar stops listing resources whose metadata poses a prompt-injection risk and removes listed ones that fail screening, curated endpoints included.

events.title: Security reporting moves to the foundation
events.detail: SECURITY.md now sends sensitive reports privately to a TSC member or primary maintainer through the x402 Slack and non-sensitive bugs to GitHub Issues; a bug bounty is announced as coming soon.

events.title: Paywall bypass reported in the V1 middleware
events.detail: Issue #3850: the deprecated V1 middleware (npm x402 1.2.0, used by x402-express and x402-hono) decodes paths before matching, so encoded route parameters skip payment. Open, with no V1 release, on 2026-11-14; V2 is not affected.

events.title: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines builds on x402
events.detail: Mastercard opened AP4M Early Access after pilots in which services answered 402 and agents signed off-chain vouchers that providers redeem later; Base was the settlement network in the pilot.

events.title: Third-party CVE for an x402 SDK: CVE-2026-113603
events.detail: The third-party CNA VulnCheck published a medium-severity SIWX payment bypass (public since 2026-10-17); GitHub mirrors it as the unreviewed GHSA-vxw2-vmfp-vrg3. The fix (PR #3840) was unmerged on 2026-11-14.

events.title: V12 discloses 25 findings, three critical
events.detail: Industry review: a Solana approval accepted as payment, cross-site SIWX login signatures and no default spending limit, all fixed in the 2.23.0 releases of August 2026 without an advisory.

events.title: x402.org home page edited; its counter is gone by 2026-11-14
events.detail: The home page, last edited on 2026-10-27, no longer showed on 2026-11-14 the Last 30 Days counter that had displayed the same 75.41M transactions and $24.24M since at least 2025-12-14 (last archived on 2026-10-24). Not announced.

events.title: @x402 2.29.0 ships the HEAD fix
events.detail: @x402/core 2.29.0, PyPI x402 2.26.0 and Go v2.29.0 require payment for HEAD requests to GET routes; @x402/svm 2.29.0 fails SVM batch-settlement verification closed when a store call fails. Go now requires Go 1.26.10.

events.title: Brave Search API sells searches over x402
events.detail: $0.005 per request over x402 V2 exact, USDC on Base, through a facilitator Brave runs, with no account or API key. Other networks and stablecoins are announced only.

events.title: Solana Foundation talk cites 400 million x402 payments (reported)
events.detail: Crypto Briefing and Decrypt reported Rishin Sharma saying at Breakpoint 2026 in London that x402 had processed more than 400 million payments and $100 million since launch; a self-reported figure from an interested party.

events.title: Third maintainer advisory: batch-settlement voucher signatures
events.detail: GHSA-5cgh-j82v-jvrj (medium, CVSS 3.1 5.4, no CVE id): the TypeScript, Go and Python voucher checks accepted ECDSA signatures that the batch-settlement contract cannot recover, so a payer could be served and later withdraw the escrow. ERC-1271 payers are unaffected.

events.title: Batch-settlement bindings tighten signature and duplicate-settle rules
events.detail: The EVM binding accepts ECDSA signatures only in the contract's form (65 bytes, low s, v of 27 or 28); the SVM binding makes a facilitator reject a concurrent duplicate settle with duplicate_settlement instead of sharing one success. The core v2 specification is unchanged.

events.title: AWS Marketplace sells x402 products in US dollars on the AWS bill
events.detail: Agents pay x402-enabled Marketplace sellers per request through AgentCore payments over AWS's own aws:base network (asset iso4217:USD), with no chain and no crypto wallet; the binding is not part of the x402 specification.

events.title: @x402 2.32.0, PyPI x402 2.29.0 and Go v2.32.0 ship the voucher fix
events.detail: The releases carry the fixes for GHSA-5cgh-j82v-jvrj, report the spec code for a recipient mismatch and reject non-canonical exact EVM amounts. The specification stays v2.0, and the advisory still listed no patched version on 2026-11-21.

events.title: Coinbase's awal CLI adds a retirement notice for Agentic Wallet
events.detail: awal 2.12.3 says Payments MCP and Agentic Wallet are being retired in favor of Coinbase Wallet MCP. The notice depends on a flag endpoint that answered 404 on 2026-11-21, so it was not active, and the CDP changelog has no retirement entry.
